title: Dress For The Weather Worksheets | PreK–K Preschool Practice with Answer Key
desc:
📚 Standards aligned: K-ESS2-1

Give your learners extra practice with Dress For The Weather! This no-prep printable pack has 3 practice pages plus a 1-page answer key for grown-ups. Just print and go.

WHAT'S INSIDE (6 pages)

  • Cover page
  • What Should I Wear?
  • Hot Day or Cold Day?
  • Bo Gets Dressed
  • Answer key (1 page): every answer, plus "Say" lines for listening pages
  • Terms of use

PERFECT FOR

  • Morning work, centers and small groups
  • Homework, early finishers and review
  • Homeschool lessons and summer practice

WHY TEACHERS LOVE IT

  • Clear directions young learners can follow
  • Friendly pictures that match each word
  • Listening pages keep the words in the answer key, so children truly listen
  • Each page matches a game on Creative Sprout Learning (What Should I Wear?, Hot Day or Cold Day?, Bo Gets Dressed), so children can play, then print and practice

💰 SAVE MORE: this pack is part of the Pre-K Bundle and the Mega Bundle.
